name: Hen egg, whole, raw (edible portion, no shell)
source: Proximate composition (per kg): water 761.5 g, protein 125.6 g, fat 95.1 g, ash 10.3 g, carbohydrate by difference 7.5 g, typical of raw whole hen egg, edible portion only (USDA FoodData Central pattern).
notes: The shell (mostly calcium carbonate) is a separate co-product not included here; this substance is the edible content only, i.e. white plus yolk in their natural proportion. It is a weighted blend and does not need to equal any fixed ratio of hen-egg-white and hen-egg-yolk, since real eggs vary; each file is sourced and closed independently.
